bagPolicy.summary: Oklahoma State applies a clear-bag policy at ticketed events. Prohibited items include backpacks, ice chests, outside food or drink, and numerous potential safety hazards.
allowed: Inspected diaper bags with an accompanying child
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: ADA parking in Lot 6 becomes available as early as 90 minutes before each game. Other lots require the credentials shown in the event parking plan.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The venue has not published specific rideshare guidance on its official venue or guest-information pages.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Concession stands operate on the ground and mezzanine levels of Gallagher-Iba Arena.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: ADA parking is in Lot 6 and opens as early as 90 minutes before the game; the arena provides accessible seating and entry assistance.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: The Athletics Center has a no-re-entry policy.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: Will-call tickets are distributed in the East Lobby to the authorized recipient with photo ID. Game-day north and south ticket windows open one hour before the event.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: The Athletics Center opens one hour before men’s basketball, women’s basketball, and wrestling events.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
